settings.appearance.display.vi_hover: Translation only — hover to show source

settings.appearance.tip.overlay_stays_vi: The overlay stays visible on screen but is invisible to all captures: it can sit on top of the dialogue area without OCR reading the translation back; recordings / streams / screenshots won't show it either.
settings.appearance.tip.speaker_name_loo: Speaker name, lookup popup border, icons on hover.
settings.appearance.tip.when_frame_is_ta: When the frame is taller than the text, place the text block (source + translation) at the top, middle or bottom. Source and translation always stay together.
settings.appearance.tip.while_overlay_is: While the overlay is locked, the mouse passes through to the game. Hold this key / combination / mouse button to temporarily click, drag and look up words on the overlay. Click the field and press a key to change it; Backspace = off.
settings.appearance.toolbar_buttons_tick: Toolbar buttons — tick to show, drag (or ↑ ↓) to reorder
settings.character.gender_macros_like_ma: Gender macros like {{Male=he;Female=she}} are handled automatically.
settings.hotkeys.run_as_admin: Always run GameSub as administrator (needed when the game runs as administrator, otherwise hotkeys / the hold-to-unlock key don't reach it)
settings.ocr.clear_on_empty: Clear text when the dialogue area is empty
settings.ocr.dedupe_ratio: Skip if similar to previous line ≥ (%)
settings.ocr.fix_spacing: Split merged words (youfinallywoke → you finally woke)
settings.ocr.group.downloadable_ocr_engi: Downloadable OCR engines (Windows OCR is built in, no download needed)
settings.ocr.installed_press_ok: Installed. Press OK in Settings to use it.
settings.ocr.name_is_in_use_it: {name} is in use — it will be fully removed when the app restarts.
settings.ocr.only_translate_while_this_a: Only translate while this app is active
settings.ocr.outline_dialogue_and_speake: Outline the dialogue and speaker name areas on screen for a few seconds.
settings.ocr.pick_dialogue_speaker_name_: Pick the dialogue / speaker name areas with the Select dialogue area / Select speaker name area buttons on the overlay.
settings.ocr.save_current_region_image_f: Save current region image for checking
settings.ocr.snap_tip: Save the captured dialogue image to a file to see what OCR actually sees (is the region offset, is the image black).
settings.ocr.tip.clear_on_empty: Clear the overlay when the dialogue ends (no text left in the area). When off, the last line stays until a new one appears.
settings.ocr.tip.dedupe_ratio: If the OCR result is at least this similar to the last translated line, skip it instead of translating again (each OCR pass may differ by a few characters). 100 = skip only exact duplicates.
settings.ocr.tip.diff_threshold: How different the dialogue image must be from the last capture to count as a change (mean brightness difference, 0–255). Increase if animated backgrounds (water, fire, effects) keep OCR running; decrease if new lines aren't detected.
settings.ocr.tip.fix_spacing: OCR sometimes merges words together. Turn on to split them again before translating; names in the subtitle pack / glossary are left intact.
settings.ocr.tip.interval_ms: How often the dialogue area is captured to check for changes. Lower = new lines are picked up faster but uses more CPU. OCR only runs when the image changes.
settings.ocr.tip.ocr_engine: Text recognition engine. Windows OCR is built into Windows, fast and light, good enough for game dialogue. RapidOCR runs offline and reads small text / busy backgrounds better but is heavier. RapidOCR and Tesseract must be downloaded in the section below.
settings.ocr.tip.ocr_lang: Language of the in-game text. Windows OCR uses codes like en-US, ja, zh-Hans-CN, ko… and needs that language pack in Windows (Settings → Time & Language → Language). Tesseract uses eng, jpn, chi_sim… RapidOCR ignores this field.
settings.ocr.tip.ocr_scale: Upscale the dialogue image before OCR. If small text (low-resolution screens) is misread, try 1.5–2. Larger is slower. 1 = unchanged.
settings.ocr.tip.stable_ms: How long the dialogue image must stay still before OCR. Games reveal text character by character: wait until it's complete so half lines aren't translated. Increase if lines get cut off; decrease for faster display.
settings.ocr.tip.target_app: Only capture & translate while this app's window is focused; pause when you switch to another app (saves CPU, avoids stray translations). Press “Refresh” to update the list of open apps.
settings.ocr.will_be_removed_when_app: will be removed when the app restarts
settings.reset.confirm:
Reset all settings to their defaults and restart the app?
Subtitle packs, glossary, vocabulary and downloaded OCR engines are kept.
settings.reset.keep: Keep the dialogue area, speaker name area and Gemini API key
settings.subs.scan_use_subs: Also use for Capture & translate area (per sentence)
settings.subs.tip.fuzzy_threshold: Minimum similarity between the OCR line and a subtitle-pack line (character-level, ignoring punctuation/case). 100% = exact matches only; lower it (e.g. 75–80%) to tolerate a few OCR errors, but too low may pick a similar-looking wrong line. Use the test box below to see the closest line's score.
settings.subs.tip.scan_use_subs: The captured area (letters, info panels…) is split into paragraphs/sentences: sentences that match the subtitle pack use its translation, only unmatched ones go to machine translation (the area's engine). With "Gemini reads image": paragraphs that fully match are replaced by the subtitle text.
